title: SEO Intelligence
description: Find winnable keyword opportunities, diagnose technical SEO issues, close content gaps, and track rankings with page-level briefs — your AI Growth Analyst's organic acquisition readout.
setup_prompt: Use SEO Intelligence for my AI Growth Analyst. With my reconciled traffic and site data, track rankings against my keyword universe, audit technical health within authorized crawl scope, score content gaps with evidence, and brief page-level optimization without deceptive practices or unapproved site changes.

setup_inputs.label: Reconciled Growth Data Foundation or equivalent model
Domains, Search Console properties, locales, and devices
Crawl scope, frequency, and politeness limits
Ranking and traffic targets with attribution window
Minimum freshness, coverage, and confidence policy

recommended_tools.name: Google Search Console MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized queries, impressions, clicks, and page performance behind a finding

recommended_tools.name: Site-crawl CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Crawl authorized scope for indexation, links, redirects, metadata, and page experience signals

recommended_tools.name: Rank-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized keyword rankings across locales and devices for tracked universes

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist rank snapshots, crawl findings, gaps, briefs, and follow-up outcomes

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Rank-sample, crawl-coverage, and Search Console reconciliation integrity
Finding reproducibility and page-brief evidence quality
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Keyword universe model, crawl architecture, history, and dashboard design
Ownership of targets and downstream consumers
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether SEO insight explains organic acquisition outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
